suggested_statement: She often declines the bath the first time it's offered. Offer it again after tea rather than insisting.
She often eats very little at meals. Offer small portions and check back with her later.
Please make sure she has actually swallowed her medication before you leave.

label_en: Said yes, then didn't follow through
label_fr: A dit oui, puis a changé d'avis
suggested_statement: She agrees to things to be polite and then changes her mind. Confirm twice before starting something she may not want.
Her hearing varies from day to day. Face her and speak slowly, and check her hearing aid is in.

label_en: Confused about the time or day
label_fr: Confuse sur l'heure ou le jour
suggested_statement: She is sometimes unsure of the day and time. Gently mention both when you arrive.
She has been unsteady walking. Stay within arm's reach whenever she is on her feet.
She has been mentioning pain but won't bring it up herself. Ask about it at the start of each visit.
Her mood is low some days. A few minutes of conversation before starting tasks helps a lot.

label_fr: La visite a chevauché la prière
suggested_statement: Visits in the afternoon often overlap with her prayers. Wait for her to finish rather than working around her.
On days she is fasting, do not offer food or drink before sunset.

label_en: Asked for family to be called
label_fr: A demandé qu'on appelle la famille
suggested_statement: She often asks for family to be called. Use the number on the fridge; it's fine to call more than once.

label_fr: Est tombée ou a presque chuté
suggested_statement: She has had near-falls recently. Check the hallway rug and bathroom mat before helping her move.

label_en: Bathroom floor was wet or slippery
label_fr: Le plancher de la salle de bain était glissant
suggested_statement: The bathroom floor is often wet. Dry it before she goes in.
The front door has been found unlocked. Please check it is locked when you leave.
She is often asleep in the early afternoon. Afternoon visits go better after 3pm.
She switches to French when she is tired. Keep instructions short and in French.

label_fr: Semblait mal à l'aise avec l'intervenant
suggested_statement: She is more at ease with a familiar worker for personal care. Please introduce yourself and explain each step.
The stove or kettle has been left on more than once. Check both before you leave.
